requirements.requirement: Record sudo command invocations in /var/log/sudo-commands.log with the invoking user and timestamp.
requirements.summary: Global sudo defaults configure the dedicated logfile and year-bearing timestamps. Direct tests before and after restart show command records containing full timestamps, invoking user `root`, target user, and command; the configuration and prior log data persisted across restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep new sudo command entries out of the general system log.
requirements.summary: The global policy disables sudo syslog output. Unique sudo events generated both before and after restart had zero matches in /var/log/messages, whose line count remained unchanged during each test.

requirements.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: The executor used the already-installed sudo facility without package changes. Alpine Linux 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts were unchanged from the lifecycle baseline through the post-restart and final snapshots.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. Sudo command auditing is globally configured in the dedicated protected file, representative events demonstrate the required fields and exclusion from the general log, the configuration survives restart, and the platform release and kernel remain unchanged. The mandatory node-restart protocol is complete and coherent with the lifecycle observations.
limitations: Behavior was directly tested only with `root` as the invoking user; coverage for a non-root sudo caller is supported by the global sudo policy but was not separately exercised.

Lifecycle failed-service collection used a systemd-oriented probe and was unsupported on Alpine; executor evidence directly confirmed the relevant OpenRC syslog service was healthy before and after restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The sudoers drop-in and dedicated log creation were necessary implementation actions (cmd-ca4a5b2ff63e4399); the sudo test invocations were bounded final evidence (cmd-bea28aa2f6124477, cmd-e91944cc02904e43); and the reboot was required by the provider-wide restart protocol (cmd-955997f685be4fc3). Temporary-file and package-health observations were unchanged, no extra listening service appeared, and the temporary configuration staging file was removed. Restart evidence is complete: healthy pre-state, acknowledgement, a changed boot ID, recovered syslog and sudo policy, retained audit data, and successful post-restart behavior, independently corroborated by lifecycle boot identities.
